[Thread 1] Storyboard prompt : Create a cinematic 4x2 storyboard contact sheet for a luxury Gucci tennis fashion campaign set in Germany during the 1970s.

The campaign takes place at an exclusive private tennis estate beside a majestic historic German castle surrounded by lush forests and mountains. The visual language should feel like a premium vintage Gucci fashion film, combining aristocratic European elegance, old-money sophistication, refined tennis culture, and timeless luxury.

MAIN CHARACTER:
A handsome Italian man in his late 20s, dark wavy hair, refined masculine features, wearing a vintage Gucci tennis outfit consisting of an off-white cream polo shirt with subtle Gucci branding, cream tailored tennis trousers, vintage tennis shoes, and a classic tennis headband. His appearance is elegant, natural and distinctly European.
WARDROBE & PROPS:
Vintage Gucci tennis polo, cream trousers, Gucci tennis accessories, vintage wooden tennis racket with Gucci detailing, vintage Gucci travel bag, luxury leather goods and subtle signature branding. Branding should feel integrated and sophisticated rather than excessive.

LOCATION:
A private clay tennis court on the grounds of a magnificent German castle. Gothic/Romanesque castle architecture, dramatic towers, manicured gardens, mature trees, distant mountains, elegant stone terraces and aristocratic estate surroundings.
STORYBOARD — 8 FRAMES:

FRAME 01 — EXT. CASTLE ESTATE — BIRD VIEW
High-angle aerial establishing shot of the magnificent castle estate and private tennis court surrounded by forests and mountains. The tennis court sits beside the castle. Establish a sense of heritage, exclusivity and grandeur.
FRAME 02 — EXT. TENNIS COURT — MEDIUM SHOT
Medium portrait of the Italian man standing on the tennis court before the match. He prepares himself calmly, wearing the vintage Gucci tennis outfit. The castle is softly blurred in the background.

FRAME 03 — EXT. TENNIS COURT — WIDE SHOT
Wide cinematic shot of the man preparing to serve. He tosses the tennis ball into the air while standing on the clay court. The magnificent castle dominates the background.

FRAME 04 — EXT. TENNIS COURT — CLOSE-UP
Extreme close-up of his hand gripping a vintage tennis racket and wearing a Gucci tennis wristband. Focus on tactile material, leather, metal, fabric and subtle Gucci details.
FRAME 05 — EXT. TENNIS COURT — MATCH PLAY — WIDE
Dynamic wide shot of the match beginning. The man executes a powerful tennis stroke with controlled elegance. Spectators sit behind the court. Castle architecture and trees frame the composition. Capture athletic movement while maintaining luxury fashion-film aesthetics.

FRAME 06 — EXT. CASTLE TERRACE — MEDIUM SHOT
The man sits calmly on an elegant stone terrace after a point, wearing sunglasses. His vintage Gucci travel bag rests beside him. He appears relaxed, confident and sophisticated. The castle and landscape remain softly visible behind him.
FRAME 07 — EXT. TENNIS COURT — CLOSE-UP FABRIC
Extreme macro close-up of the Gucci polo shirt fabric, collar, buttons, stitching and subtle Gucci signature logo. Emphasize luxurious textile craftsmanship, tactile detail and premium material quality.

FRAME 08 — EXT. CASTLE ESTATE — SUNSET — WIDE
Epic wide shot of the castle estate and tennis court at sunset. Golden sunlight falls across the castle, mountains and surrounding forest. The tennis court becomes part of the grand landscape. End with a feeling of heritage, timelessness and luxury.
VISUAL STYLE:
1970s Italian luxury fashion cinema, vintage Gucci campaign aesthetic, sophisticated European aristocratic atmosphere, cinematic elegance, understated wealth, timeless fashion photography, natural human proportions, realistic skin texture, authentic vintage wardrobe, tactile materials.

CAMERA:
Panavision C-Series Anamorphic lenses, 1970s cinema optics, anamorphic compression, subtle lens distortion, shallow depth of field where appropriate, cinematic framing, natural perspective, elegant camera composition.
FILM STOCK:
Kodak Eastman 5247, 1970s Eastmancolor aesthetic, photochemical texture, warm vintage color science, subtle halation around highlights, visible but refined film grain, soft contrast, slightly faded blacks, organic exposure roll-off, natural skin tones.

LIGHTING:
Natural sunlight, warm late-afternoon illumination, soft directional sunlight, realistic shadows, subtle atmospheric haze, golden-hour light in the final frame. Avoid artificial studio lighting.
COLOR PALETTE:
Warm cream, ivory, muted green, earthy brown, terracotta clay, deep forest green, warm gold and subtle red Gucci accents. Rich but slightly desaturated 1970s color palette.

COMPOSITION:
Luxury editorial photography, balanced negative space, elegant symmetry, sophisticated visual hierarchy, premium fashion campaign framing. Each frame should feel like a still from the same continuous cinematic film.
TEXT / STORYBOARD DESIGN:
Present the result as a professional cinematic storyboard contact sheet with 8 frames arranged in a 4x2 grid. Each frame includes a small cinematic scene heading, action description, camera information, lens/film information and duration. Use an elegant black-and-gold luxury editorial layout inspired by vintage film production storyboards.

OVERALL FEEL:
Gucci luxury tennis campaign meets 1970s European aristocratic cinema. Elegant, masculine, refined, nostalgic, cinematic, prestigious, timeless and effortlessly luxurious

广告发生在一座专属的私人网球庄园内，庄园位于一座宏伟的德国历史城堡旁，四周环绕着葱郁森林与群山。视觉语言应呈现高级复古 Gucci 时尚电影的质感，融合贵族式欧洲优雅、老钱风格、精致网球文化与永恒奢华。

MAIN CHARACTER:

WARDROBE & PROPS:

FRAME 01 — EXT. CASTLE ESTATE — BIRD VIEW
高角度航拍建立镜头，展示宏伟的城堡庄园与被森林和群山环绕的私人网球场。网球场紧邻城堡。建立起传承、专属感与宏伟气势。
